name: Ahmed Khan
content: Babar delivered a hospital platform that our wards actually use. He thinks in business outcomes — billing leakage, pharmacy stockouts, report latency — not just tickets.

name: Sara Malik

content: Month-end used to be chaos. The reporting factory and POS reconciliation Babar built gave us one version of the truth.
